name: lab706PatientList
description: Patient-list template for the MOH 240 laboratory register (A-AA). Joined onto lab706Base per person; every presentation field is derived here from the raw facts - names/addresses/identifiers/telephone as per-row correlated subqueries (safe on a paginated page), coded answers translated through etl.concept_value_map (cvt = the test concept, cvm = the result concept). Panel tests render the FULL analyte list in results, driven by etl.concept_set_map (so an analyte with no result prints 'Not done'), ordered by cs.sort_weight/concept_set, with the order row's own single value appended after ' | ' when present (never dropped); when NO analyte of a mapped panel has a result but the order row carries its own value, the all-'Not done' member list is suppressed and only that value prints (v1.6); unmapped panels fall back to composing the observed member rows of etl.flat_moh_706_report_results, then the single value. amount_charged and receipt_number aggregate the whole encounter's non-voided, non-cancelled bill line items (D7; encounter-level first - this also neutralises the double-count risk of adopted orders on obs-only rows - with the order-level sum as fallback when the row has no encounter). v1.6: results de-noised for panels with nothing itemised - when no analyte of a mapped panel has any result but the order row carries its own value, the 'Not done' member list is suppressed and just the value prints (the full member list still prints when at least one analyte has a result, or when there is no value at all). Names are de-noised as well: a trailing ', DETAILED' dictionary suffix (any spacing, case-insensitive) is stripped from investigation_required and the results member labels, falling back to the raw concept id when nothing remains. v1.5: billing simplified for performance - amount_charged/receipt_number resolve the order's line items by driving FROM hie.bill_orders on bo.order_no (= lab_no, else the order_id-resolved order number; covers adopted obs-only rows) joined to cashier_bill_line_item.uuid and the bill, with the plain order_id sum/receipt as fallback; the encounter-level arms and all CONVERT/COLLATE clauses are gone (production collations are compatible, per the claims service joining the same tables without collation handling) - the v1.4 nested IN-lists were a per-row dependent-subquery blowup on the real database. clinician_name reads amrs.orders.orderer first (D9: the requesting clinician), then the encounter provider, then obs 1496. date_sample_received falls back fhir report_date_created -> orders.date_created (order-placement stamp, labelled as such in the release note) -> obs_datetime (D5); analysed/dispatched keep derived COALESCE chains. testing_officer is the fhir performer when present, else the creator of the result obs resolved through amrs.users (D11; flat v3.2 result_creator). prior_treatment, condition_of_specimen and signature have no standard-model source and stay NULL - DECIDED 2026-10-21 (report owner): no concepts exist for them yet, so blank is the correct output; do not substitute another field. See MOH-706-REGISTER-BLANK-COLUMNS-PLAN.md. Alias names are the app contract - see moh-240.columns.ts. v1.3: clinical_diagnosis no longer keys on the row encounter (often the lab/order encounter): it reads the patient's dx_rank 1-2 encounter diagnoses (dx_rank=2 is the primary diagnosis and is preferred/listed first) from the latest clinical encounter within the reporting period, preferring an encounter at/before the test datetime (fallback: latest in-period one, then the row encounter's own latest diagnosis, dx_rank=2 preferred) - non-coded diagnosis text is printed when no coded answer exists. v1.2: blank-columns release (plan F4/F4.5a/F5/F6). v1.1: revisit_no counts only encounters within the selected reporting period.

expressionOptions.expression: DATE_FORMAT(fbc.test_datetime, '%d/%m/%Y')
(SELECT pi.identifier FROM amrs.patient_identifier pi WHERE pi.patient_id = fbc.person_id AND pi.voided = 0 AND pi.preferred = 1 ORDER BY pi.patient_identifier_id DESC LIMIT 1)

(SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT IFNULL(e2.visit_id, e2.encounter_id)) + 1 FROM amrs.encounter e2 WHERE e2.patient_id = fbc.person_id AND e2.voided = 0 AND e2.encounter_datetime >= '{startDate}' AND e2.encounter_datetime <= '{endDate}' AND e2.encounter_datetime < fbc.test_datetime)

(SELECT CONCAT_WS(' ', pn.given_name, NULLIF(pn.middle_name, ''), pn.family_name) FROM amrs.person_name pn WHERE pn.person_id = fbc.person_id AND pn.voided = 0 ORDER BY pn.preferred DESC, pn.person_name_id DESC LIMIT 1)
TIMESTAMPDIFF(YEAR, p.birthdate, fbc.test_datetime)

(SELECT CONCAT_WS(' / ', NULLIF(pa.state_province, ''), NULLIF(pa.county_district, '')) FROM amrs.person_address pa WHERE pa.person_id = fbc.person_id AND pa.voided = 0 ORDER BY pa.preferred DESC, pa.person_address_id DESC LIMIT 1)

(SELECT CONCAT_WS(', ', NULLIF(pa.city_village, ''), NULLIF(pa.address3, '')) FROM amrs.person_address pa WHERE pa.person_id = fbc.person_id AND pa.voided = 0 ORDER BY pa.preferred DESC, pa.person_address_id DESC LIMIT 1)
(SELECT pa.value FROM amrs.person_attribute pa WHERE pa.person_id = fbc.person_id AND pa.voided = 0 AND pa.person_attribute_type_id IN (10, 48) ORDER BY pa.person_attribute_id DESC LIMIT 1)

COALESCE((SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(COALESCE(cvm_ed.name, ed.diagnosis_non_coded, CAST(ed.diagnosis_coded AS CHAR)) ORDER BY ed.dx_rank DESC, ed.diagnosis_id SEPARATOR '; ') FROM amrs.encounter_diagnosis ed LEFT JOIN etl.concept_value_map cvm_ed ON cvm_ed.concept_id = ed.diagnosis_coded WHERE ed.voided = 0 AND ed.dx_rank IN (1, 2) AND ed.encounter_id = (SELECT ed2.encounter_id FROM amrs.encounter_diagnosis ed2 JOIN amrs.encounter e2 ON e2.encounter_id = ed2.encounter_id WHERE ed2.patient_id = fbc.person_id AND ed2.voided = 0 AND ed2.dx_rank IN (1, 2) AND e2.voided = 0 AND e2.encounter_datetime >= '{startDate}' AND e2.encounter_datetime <= '{endDate}' ORDER BY (e2.encounter_datetime <= fbc.test_datetime) DESC, e2.encounter_datetime DESC, e2.encounter_id DESC LIMIT 1)), (SELECT COALESCE(cvm_ed2.name, ed3.diagnosis_non_coded, CAST(ed3.diagnosis_coded AS CHAR)) FROM amrs.encounter_diagnosis ed3 LEFT JOIN etl.concept_value_map cvm_ed2 ON cvm_ed2.concept_id = ed3.diagnosis_coded WHERE ed3.encounter_id = fbc.encounter_id AND ed3.voided = 0 AND ed3.dx_rank IN (1, 2) ORDER BY ed3.dx_rank DESC, ed3.diagnosis_id DESC LIMIT 1))
NULL

(SELECT COALESCE(cvm_sp.name, CAST(o_sp.value_coded AS CHAR)) FROM amrs.obs o_sp LEFT JOIN etl.concept_value_map cvm_sp ON cvm_sp.concept_id = o_sp.value_coded WHERE o_sp.encounter_id = fbc.encounter_id AND o_sp.concept_id = 10338 AND o_sp.voided = 0 ORDER BY o_sp.obs_datetime DESC, o_sp.obs_id DESC LIMIT 1)
NULL
COALESCE(NULLIF(REGEXP_REPLACE(cvt.name, '[[:space:]]*,[[:space:]]*DETAILED[[:space:]]*$', ''), ''), CAST(fbc.concept_id AS CHAR))
DATE_FORMAT(fbc.test_datetime, '%d/%m/%Y')
DATE_FORMAT(COALESCE(fbc.report_date_created, (SELECT o_rc.date_created FROM amrs.orders o_rc WHERE o_rc.order_id = fbc.order_id), fbc.obs_datetime), '%d/%m/%Y')

COALESCE((SELECT CONCAT_WS(' ', pn_o.given_name, NULLIF(pn_o.middle_name, ''), pn_o.family_name) FROM amrs.orders o_or JOIN amrs.provider pr_or ON pr_or.provider_id = o_or.orderer JOIN amrs.person_name pn_o ON pn_o.person_id = pr_or.person_id AND pn_o.voided = 0 WHERE o_or.order_id = fbc.order_id ORDER BY pn_o.preferred DESC, pn_o.person_name_id DESC LIMIT 1), (SELECT CONCAT_WS(' ', pn2.given_name, NULLIF(pn2.middle_name, ''), pn2.family_name) FROM amrs.encounter_provider ep JOIN amrs.provider pr ON pr.provider_id = ep.provider_id JOIN amrs.person_name pn2 ON pn2.person_id = pr.person_id AND pn2.voided = 0 WHERE ep.encounter_id = fbc.encounter_id ORDER BY pn2.preferred DESC, pn2.person_name_id DESC LIMIT 1), (SELECT COALESCE(cvm_cl.name, CAST(o_cl.value_coded AS CHAR)) FROM amrs.obs o_cl LEFT JOIN etl.concept_value_map cvm_cl ON cvm_cl.concept_id = o_cl.value_coded WHERE o_cl.encounter_id = fbc.encounter_id AND o_cl.concept_id = 1496 AND o_cl.voided = 0 ORDER BY o_cl.obs_id DESC LIMIT 1))
DATE_FORMAT(COALESCE(fbc.report_date_changed, fbc.report_date_created, fbc.obs_datetime), '%d/%m/%Y')

COALESCE(CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM etl.concept_set_map cs0 WHERE cs0.concept_id = fbc.concept_id) THEN CONCAT_WS(' | ', CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM etl.concept_set_map cs_any JOIN etl.flat_moh_706_report_results rr_any ON rr_any.report_id = fbc.report_id AND rr_any.member_concept_id = cs_any.concept_set LEFT JOIN etl.concept_value_map cvm_any ON cvm_any.concept_id = rr_any.result_concept_id WHERE cs_any.concept_id = fbc.concept_id AND (cvm_any.name IS NOT NULL OR rr_any.result_numeric IS NOT NULL OR rr_any.result_datetime IS NOT NULL OR (rr_any.result_text IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(rr_any.result_text) <> ''))) OR COALESCE(cvm.name, fbc.result_numeric, fbc.result_text, fbc.result_datetime) IS NULL THEN (SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(CONCAT(COALESCE(NULLIF(REGEXP_REPLACE(cvt_m.name, '[[:space:]]*,[[:space:]]*DETAILED[[:space:]]*$', ''), ''), CAST(cs.concept_set AS CHAR)), ': ', COALESCE(cvm_a.name, CAST(rr.result_numeric AS CHAR), TRIM(rr.result_text), DATE_FORMAT(rr.result_datetime, '%Y-%m-%d'), 'Not done')) ORDER BY cs.sort_weight, cs.concept_set SEPARATOR '; ') FROM etl.concept_set_map cs LEFT JOIN etl.flat_moh_706_report_results rr ON rr.report_id = fbc.report_id AND rr.member_concept_id = cs.concept_set LEFT JOIN etl.concept_value_map cvt_m ON cvt_m.concept_id = cs.concept_set LEFT JOIN etl.concept_value_map cvm_a ON cvm_a.concept_id = rr.result_concept_id WHERE cs.concept_id = fbc.concept_id) ELSE NULL END, COALESCE(cvm.name, CAST(fbc.result_numeric AS CHAR), TRIM(fbc.result_text), DATE_FORMAT(fbc.result_datetime, '%Y-%m-%d'))) END, (SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(CONCAT(COALESCE(NULLIF(REGEXP_REPLACE(cvt_m2.name, '[[:space:]]*,[[:space:]]*DETAILED[[:space:]]*$', ''), ''), CAST(rr2.member_concept_id AS CHAR)), ': ', COALESCE(cvm_a2.name, CAST(rr2.result_numeric AS CHAR), TRIM(rr2.result_text), DATE_FORMAT(rr2.result_datetime, '%Y-%m-%d'))) ORDER BY rr2.result_obs_id SEPARATOR '; ') FROM etl.flat_moh_706_report_results rr2 LEFT JOIN etl.concept_value_map cvt_m2 ON cvt_m2.concept_id = rr2.member_concept_id LEFT JOIN etl.concept_value_map cvm_a2 ON cvm_a2.concept_id = rr2.result_concept_id WHERE rr2.report_id = fbc.report_id AND rr2.member_concept_id <> fbc.concept_id), COALESCE(cvm.name, CAST(fbc.result_numeric AS CHAR), TRIM(fbc.result_text), DATE_FORMAT(fbc.result_datetime, '%Y-%m-%d')))
DATE_FORMAT(COALESCE(fbc.report_issued, fbc.report_date_changed, fbc.report_date_created), '%d/%m/%Y')

COALESCE((SELECT SUM(bli.price * bli.quantity) FROM hie.bill_orders bo JOIN amrs.cashier_bill_line_item bli ON bli.uuid = bo.line_item_uuid JOIN amrs.cashier_bill b ON b.bill_id = bli.bill_id WHERE bo.order_no = COALESCE(fbc.lab_no, (SELECT o_ord.order_number FROM amrs.orders o_ord WHERE o_ord.order_id = fbc.order_id)) AND bli.voided = 0 AND b.voided = 0 AND bli.status <> 'CANCELLED'), (SELECT SUM(bli2.price * bli2.quantity) FROM amrs.cashier_bill_line_item bli2 JOIN amrs.cashier_bill b2 ON b2.bill_id = bli2.bill_id WHERE bli2.order_id = fbc.order_id AND bli2.voided = 0 AND b2.voided = 0 AND bli2.status <> 'CANCELLED'))

COALESCE((SELECT b.receipt_number FROM hie.bill_orders bo JOIN amrs.cashier_bill_line_item bli ON bli.uuid = bo.line_item_uuid JOIN amrs.cashier_bill b ON b.bill_id = bli.bill_id WHERE bo.order_no = COALESCE(fbc.lab_no, (SELECT o_ord.order_number FROM amrs.orders o_ord WHERE o_ord.order_id = fbc.order_id)) AND b.receipt_number IS NOT NULL AND bli.voided = 0 AND b.voided = 0 AND bli.status <> 'CANCELLED' ORDER BY b.date_created DESC, bo.id DESC LIMIT 1), (SELECT b2.receipt_number FROM amrs.cashier_bill_line_item bli2 JOIN amrs.cashier_bill b2 ON b2.bill_id = bli2.bill_id WHERE bli2.order_id = fbc.order_id AND b2.receipt_number IS NOT NULL AND bli2.voided = 0 AND b2.voided = 0 AND bli2.status <> 'CANCELLED' ORDER BY b2.date_created DESC, bli2.bill_line_item_id DESC LIMIT 1))

(SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(COALESCE(cvm_rf.name, CAST(o_rf.value_coded AS CHAR), o_rf.value_text) SEPARATOR '; ') FROM amrs.obs o_rf LEFT JOIN etl.concept_value_map cvm_rf ON cvm_rf.concept_id = o_rf.value_coded WHERE o_rf.encounter_id = fbc.encounter_id AND o_rf.concept_id IN (1272, 1932, 9552) AND o_rf.voided = 0)

CONCAT_WS('; ', NULLIF((SELECT o_cm.value_text FROM amrs.obs o_cm WHERE o_cm.encounter_id = fbc.encounter_id AND o_cm.concept_id = 9467 AND o_cm.voided = 0 ORDER BY o_cm.obs_id DESC LIMIT 1), ''), NULLIF(fbc.instructions, ''))

COALESCE(fbc.testing_officer, (SELECT CONCAT_WS(' ', pn_u.given_name, NULLIF(pn_u.middle_name, ''), pn_u.family_name) FROM amrs.users u JOIN amrs.person_name pn_u ON pn_u.person_id = u.person_id AND pn_u.voided = 0 WHERE u.user_id = fbc.result_creator ORDER BY pn_u.preferred DESC, pn_u.person_name_id DESC LIMIT 1))
NULL
